name: Seed and pre-seed
description: Companies that just announced a seed, pre-seed, or angel round.
queries: "seed funding" secures OR closes OR lands
startup funding roundup this week raised seed pre-seed
goal: Alert when a startup announces a new seed, pre-seed, or angel funding round. Ignore Series A and later, debt facilities, grants, accelerator batch announcements that name no round, funds raised by venture firms, rounds that are only rumored or in talks and not yet closed, and opinion or analysis pieces that do not report a specific new round.

watchQueries.q: startup raises million seed OR "Series A" OR "Series B" OR round

watchQueries: startup raises funding Brazil OR Mexico OR Colombia OR Chile OR Argentina
startup raises funding Singapore OR Indonesia OR Vietnam OR Philippines OR Japan
Saudi OR UAE OR Egypt OR Nigeria OR Kenya startup raises funding
